claude_only.name: Which single name form is the legal name in the jurisdiction of formation, and which register or constitutive document evidences it?
In which languages and scripts is each name form authoritative, and is any Latin transliteration normative or merely convenience?
Over which interval was each name form valid, and is the interval closed, open-ended or unknown?
Is the name form unique within its register, and may two distinct organizations legitimately carry the same string?
What is the ordered sequence of legal names, and which change event caused each transition?
Did any recorded name change coincide with a change of legal identity rather than a mere renaming?
When was each historical name observed or ingested, as distinct from when it became legally effective?
Under which governed scheme was each identifier issued, and what is the registered scheme designator for that scheme?
Which authority issued the identifier, and is that authority listed in a governed registration-authority registry?
Can the identifier be reassigned, retired or superseded, and what happens to references when it is?
How was the identifier verified against its issuing source, and when was that verification last performed?
Which identifier is the canonical key for this organization record, and which rule in the identity priority selected it?
Under which events may the canonical key change, and how are prior keys kept resolvable?
If the organization has no external identifier at all, what dimension-assigned identifier is used and who assigned it?
Within which namespace is the canonical key unique, and is that namespace globally resolvable?
Which attributes and sources were compared to conclude that two candidate records denote the same organization?
Who decided the merge or split, when, and is the decision reversible?
Does an upstream register already flag one of the records as a duplicate or annulled registration?
Which candidate pairs were explicitly rejected as non-matches, so the same comparison is not repeated?
Which ELF code and jurisdiction pair describes the organization's legal form, and which code-list version was used?
If no listed legal form applies, is the correct representation 8888 (pending listing) or 9999 (no separate legal form), and why?
Has the legal form changed through conversion, and what is the effective date of each form assignment?
Is the legal form valid only at a sub-national level requiring an ISO 3166-2 jurisdiction code?
Which entity category and subcategory apply, and which facts of the record does that category make mandatory or inapplicable?
Does the organization have separate legal personality, and if not, which legal person bears its rights and obligations?
Is the organization unregistered or informal, such that registration, standing and succession findings do not apply?
Is this a government or international-organization subject whose formation rests on statute or treaty rather than registration?
Under which classification scheme and revision was each activity code assigned, and at which hierarchy level?
Which activity is the principal one, and by what criterion was principality determined?
Was the code assigned by the organization, by a register or by a statistical authority, and does that change its weight?
How are codes from a superseded revision carried forward, and is the mapping one-to-one?
Which statistical unit types is this organization mapped to, and by which statistical authority?
Does the mapped enterprise span legal units other than this organization, and which ones?
Where is the group's global decision centre, and does it differ from this organization's jurisdiction?
Where the statistical view and the legal view disagree, which is authoritative for a given consumer?
Is this purpose statement a constitutive object clause, a governing-body resolution or self-declared communication?
Which authority granted the non-profit, charitable or public-benefit status, under which instrument, and is it time-limited?
Does the declared purpose legally restrict what the organization may do, and what is the consequence of acting outside it?
When was the purpose statement last reviewed or reaffirmed, and does it still match the registered object clause?
On what counting basis and for which reference period is each size figure stated?
Who produced the size figure — the organization, a register, or a third party — and is it audited?
Which size class does the figure place the organization in, under which jurisdiction's thresholds?
Does the figure cover this organization alone or a consolidated group, and which entities are included?
On what date did the organization legally come into existence, and is that the same as its first registration date?
Which instrument created the organization — articles, deed, statute, treaty or a founding resolution — and where is it held?
In which jurisdiction and at which location was the organization founded, and does that differ from its current jurisdiction?
If no formation date is known or the organization predates its register, how is that recorded without fabricating a date?
Which register holds an entry for this organization, and what is its governed register code?
What entry or registration number does that register assign, and what is its syntax and check rule?
How many registers hold entries for this organization, and which is authoritative for which fact?
Does the entry describe a branch or a foreign company rather than a domestically constituted organization?
Is the organization itself currently in existence and operating, and on what date was that last established?
What is the standing of each record about the organization, separately from the organization's own status?
Where a status is qualified (for example administration, liquidation or struck-off pending), what is the qualifying detail and the governing procedure?
How does a national status value map onto the model's normalised status, and what is lost in the mapping?
Which recurring obligations apply to this organization, under which instrument, and at what frequency?
What is the next due date for each obligation, and what is the consequence of missing it?
What evidence shows an obligation was fulfilled, and where is that evidence retrievable?
Is the organization exempt from an otherwise applicable obligation, and on what recorded basis?
What type of lifecycle event occurred, and which fields of the organization record does it affect?
What are the event's effective date, its recorded date at the authority, and the observation time in this system?
Which validation documents evidence the event, and who validated them?
Is the event completed, in progress or withdrawn, and can it be superseded by a later correction?
Did this change preserve the organization's identity, or did it terminate one subject and create another?
Which organizations are predecessors and which are successors, and what is the cardinality of the transition?
If a successor exists but has no identifier, how is it recorded without inventing one?
Which identifiers, registrations, obligations and relationships transfer to the successor and which lapse?
Which relationship type connects this organization to the other party, and in which direction?
Which distinct periods apply — relationship validity, accounting period and document filing period — and do they differ?
What quantified measure describes the relationship, and by which measurement method and unit?
If no parent can be reported, which exception reason applies and when will it be reviewed?
What type of interest does the interested party hold, in what amount or range, and is it held directly or indirectly?
Is this interest asserted as beneficial ownership or control by a natural person, and under which jurisdiction's threshold?
Where the interested party is unknown or unspecified, what reason is recorded and what is the follow-up?
For an indirect interest, which component records describe each step of the ownership chain?
Who asserted this ownership statement, on what date, from which source type, and under what licence is it published?
Which official organizational roles exist for this organization's legal form, and what are their governed codes?
What may a holder of each role bind the organization to, and are there joint-signature or threshold constraints?
Is the appointment currently in force, and what are its start and end dates as recorded by the authority?
Is a claimed title an official role under local legislation or an internal functional title with no statutory effect?
Which external body is the organization affiliated with or accredited by, and what is that body's own identifier?
What rights, obligations or claims does the affiliation confer, and is it publicly verifiable?
Over which period is the affiliation or accreditation valid, and what triggers its lapse or withdrawal?
Is this link genuinely non-controlling, or does it in substance confer control that belongs in the ownership layer?
Which address is the registered or legal address, as distinct from the headquarters and other addresses?
Is the registered address disputed, undeliverable or served by a third-party provider, and since when?
When did the registered address last change, and which lifecycle event and filing recorded the change?
In which language and script is the address authoritative, and is a transliterated form required for interchange?
What kind of presence is this — registered branch, operating site, local unit or service point — and is it separately registered?
Over which period was the site active, and what evidences its opening and closing?
Which geographic areas does the organization serve from this site, and at what granularity is that recorded?
Which place or facility record does this site resolve to, and who maintains that record?
Under which electronic addressing scheme is the organization reachable, and what is the scheme-qualified address?
How was each channel verified as belonging to this organization, and when?
What is each channel authorised for — legal service, invoicing, general enquiry or public communication?
Which channels are retired, and are prior references redirected or tombstoned?
From which source was each assertion derived, of what source type, and under what licence may it be reused?
Which agent asserted the value, and on whose behalf were they acting?
Was the value copied, transformed or inferred, and from which prior version was it derived?
Are event time and observation/ingestion time recorded separately for this assertion, and with what precision?
What corroboration level applies to this record, and against which validation authority and documents was it established?
How stale is each value relative to its source's own update cadence, and when must it be refreshed?
Which required fields are absent or only partially available, and is that a source limitation or an ingestion gap?
What version or entity tag did the source return, and how are lost updates prevented on write-back?
What disclosure class does each field group carry — publicly disclosed, licensed, restricted or personal-data-bearing?
Under which licence was source data obtained, and does that licence permit redistribution in the intended projection?
Which fields identify natural persons, and what minimisation is applied before the record is shared?
How long is each class retained, what triggers deletion or archival, and what survives as a tombstone?
How can the organization or a data subject request correction or erasure, and how is the outcome evidenced?
To which external standard, version and element does each model element map, and is the mapping exact, broader, narrower or partial?
Is a conformance claim being made, and if so what evidence supports it, or is this alignment only?
Where two sources assert different values for the same fact, what is recorded and which source prevails for which consumer?
Which projections are published from this model, and which fields does each deliberately omit?

grok_only.name: What are the current legal names of this organization, in which languages, and which one is treated as primary in the home register?
Which authority or constituting instrument is the master source for the legal name, and does that source allow more than one official legal name?
If multiple legal names exist, are they translations of one name or distinct legal designations, and which name must be used on filings in each official language?
Which trading, doing-business-as or other alternative names are currently in force, and in which jurisdictions or channels may they be used?
What former legal or trading names has the organization carried, and what event retired each name?
Which ASCII-transliterated or Romanized name forms exist for matching and messaging, and what was the source-language name?
What is the authoritative legal identifier in the home registration system, which agency issued it, and when?
What other identifiers (tax, VAT, directory, ISO 6523, national statistical) are bound to this subject, and which must not be treated as the legal-status identifier?
What UUID or ULID has the adopting Dimension assigned, and how does it map to master-system and global identifiers without replacing them?
Has any identifier scheme reported a duplicate, annulled or superseded identifier for this same legal entity, and which identifier survives?
What is the current LEI of this organization, which LOU manages it, and what is its registration status and next renewal date?
Is this subject eligible for an LEI under ISO 17442 (can it enter contracts or is it legally or financially responsible), and if not, why is no LEI expected?
Has this LEI been marked DUPLICATE, ANNULLED, TRANSFERRED or PENDING_TRANSFER, and which LEI or LOU is surviving?
Is this subject an informal organization, a formal organization recognized in a jurisdiction, a registered legal entity, or an umbrella that holds several legal entities?
Can this organization enter contracts and bear legal obligations in its own name, or does another registered entity act for it?
If the subject is a sole trader or person acting in a business capacity, is the person-as-human modelled elsewhere and only the business capacity kept here?
What GLEIF entity category and sub-category apply, and what evidence supports that assignment?
If category is BRANCH, is this a lead international branch with its own LEI, or only a site of the headquarters legal entity?
If the subject is a government unit or international organization, which SNA-style subsector applies and is it eligible for an LEI despite not being incorporated?
What ISO 20275 ELF code and local-language legal form name apply in the home jurisdiction, and which ELF list version was used?
Does this entity have no separate legal form (ELF 9999), and if so what is the factual basis?
Has the organization converted from one legal form to another, and did that conversion keep the same legal-entity subject or create a successor?
What legal-form code and label does the home register use, and how does it map to ELF?
Is legal form intrinsic to the subject (affecting powers and identifiers) so it should be modelled as a typed class, or only a taxonomic label?
Which similarly named foreign legal forms must not be treated as equivalent to this form?
Which activity classification scheme and version is authoritative for this record in its statistical or regulatory context?
Which activity codes are assigned, at what hierarchical level, and with which labels?
If the record must be reported under two revisions (for example NACE Rev. 2 and 2.1), what is the correspondence for each assigned class?
Which assigned activity is primary, and by what rule (value added, employment, register declaration)?
Which additional activities are secondary or ancillary, and are they still current?
Is the activity assignment self-declared by the entity, assigned by a statistical office, or copied from a register, and what is its quality?
Which additional classification schemes apply (charity type, institutional sector, directory tags), with scheme, concept and validity?
Is the organization a charity or nonprofit in a named jurisdiction, under which legal or tax status, and which identifier scheme proves it?
If the organization is a public body, which institutional sector or GLEIF government sub-category applies?
In which register is this organization recorded, under which entity identifier, and on what registration date?
In which other public or private registers (tax, charity, licensed-activity, LEI) does a record exist, and which of those confer legal status?
If there is no founding registry entry, why is the subject still an organization and what evidence identifies it?
What is the jurisdiction of legal formation and registration, at country or regional grain?
How does the legal jurisdiction differ from headquarters country, tax residence and principal place of business?
If the country has multiple regional registers (for example Germany or Spain), which regional register and 3166-2 code is home?
What is the current operating status of the legal entity itself (active, inactive, or not applicable), as of when, and according to which source?
What is the registration status of each major identifier (LEI, home-register number), including lapsed, duplicate, retired or pending states?
If the entity is inactive, was it dissolved, merged, found illegitimate, or is the reason unknown, and which successor if any continues it?
What is the home-register standing code and label, in which scheme, and what does it legally imply for contracting?
Is the organization in an insolvency, administration, receivership, strike-off or similar procedure, under which law, and is that procedure still open?
Has the organization been restored after strike-off, or continued into another jurisdiction, and did identity persist?
To what level is the current organization record corroborated, against which authority, and as of when?
Which document types and references were used to validate the current facts or the latest legal-entity event?
If validation is entity-supplied only, pending, or the LEI is lapsed, what quality exceptions apply to downstream use?
On what datetime was the organization first established as a legal or social subject, in which jurisdiction, and what is the evidence?
How does entity creation datetime differ from home-register registration datetime and from first identifier assignment datetime?
Which persons or organizations founded this subject, and at which place, as references rather than full person records?
Which legal-entity events are in force or completed for this organization, with type, group, and status on the event timeline?
For each event, what was the legally effective datetime in the formation jurisdiction versus the datetime it was recorded in this system or in GLEIS?
Which identity fields were expected to change because of the event, and which documents validated it?
Which organizations are predecessors of this subject, through which event types, and did they cease?
Which organizations are successors, including multiple surviving entities after a split, and which identifiers should now be used?
Did the event preserve this subject identity or create a new organization subject that must receive a new canonical id?
Has the organization ceased, on what effective datetime, under which reason, and is winding-up still in progress?
Which identifiers remain the correct historical keys after cessation, and which must not be reassigned or reused for a new entity?
How long must the dissolved organization's identity and lineage remain available for resolution and audit, and who is the residual steward?
What is the current stated purpose, mission or objects clause, in which language, and is it from a charter or self-declared?
Which controlled vocabulary terms, if any, denote purpose or remit for this organization?
Which charter or constituting instrument is the master source for objects and powers, without duplicating that instrument here?
What is the current registered office or legal address, in which language and jurisdiction, and what location-record does it point to?
What is the headquarters or primary operating address, and how does it differ from the registered office?
Which other sites, branches-as-locations or international branch entities are current, and which of those are separate organization subjects?
What public contact channels (email, telephone, contact page, primary site) are currently valid for this organization?
Which channel is valid for formal legal notices, and is it the registered office, a registered email, or another designated address?
Which contact channels are non-public and under what access exception may they be used?
Who is the steward of this Dimension's organization record, in which role, and through which officer or system account?
Which registrars steward authoritative copies, and which copy is master for which field group?
Who is authorized to create, update or request deletion of identity fields, and under what evidence standard?
Which fields may appear on a public directory card, and which identifier history or internal declarations must be omitted?
Which fields are in the compliance profile, who may read it, and what audit is required?
What is the retention rule after last activity or dissolution, and under what exception may the record be deleted or anonymized?
Which external vocabularies is this record intended to align to, at which versions, and with which claimed conformance if any?
Which known conflicts (multiple legal names, status vocabularies, activity-revision mismatch) affect this particular organization?
Which identifiers and IRIs should be emitted for cross-system interchange (LEI, ISO 6523, home-register URI, Dimension id)?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
